result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot** as the best overall CRM. It's relatively easy to learn, has a useful free version, and can grow with your business.

However, the best choice depends on whether your team focuses on sales, customer relationships, marketing, or all three.

(Best overall)

- Great free starting plan (up to 2 users).
- Contact management and deal tracking.
- Email integration and sales pipeline.
- Marketing and customer service tools.

Best for teams wanting an all-in-one platform.

[Visit HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

- Straightforward interface.

Best for teams actively managing leads and closing deals.

![The Best CRM Software for Designers, Artists & Real Estate Agents](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VIaaVCsbSl_2HEhaNS7jaJq8M_qMRSRNnjnm4ih0BS1XW1i1dLOL1hzUuJbbQAd2oJmyek348JWDCbhZ4_llPc5MXQMU75Xd7mDacN4WycxgUOxd_i41eEMQmIEsUk3gC2v6kQv05B-0CnauDSxnGfZTdYq_06PA6HE7PRmCp51gbAogWba4zKaxdqnPKpN-?purpose=fullsize)
